runtime_scope.operation: Rewrite middle member final byte, restore mtime and verify same length; compare both directions and healthy pair; rescan must retain exactly healthy a/c group. Unix fixture asserts unchanged device/inode.

source_contract_findings: Hash equality is byte-confirmed by exact scan, unlike digest-only publication examined in competitor.
compare_files validates both observations after final caller checkpoint, with no caller callback during final publication validation.
ContentSnapshot.verify rereads complete digest and validates original identity/time stamp; metadata alone is not content proof.
Report.complete excludes cancellation/I/O/change/limit omissions but does not claim an atomic filesystem snapshot.
Existing checkpoint-sweep test explicitly allows late mutation after last validation to remain unobserved; no global atomicity claim.
limits: Single focused integration target on current macOS host, no Windows run and no all-feature/workspace gate.
Four sizes and eight authored mode cases do not prove all mutation schedules or multi-GiB concurrency.
Library exposes observation evidence; subsequent destructive actions need their own immutable-source/transactional contract.
No production change or performance measurement in this increment; pHash investigation deferred.
